safety_concepts.text: Respond to every alarm by going to the patient; do not rely on silencing. If ventilation is inadequate and the cause is not immediately correctable, use the unit's emergency ventilation method and call for help.
Do not change alarm limits or modes unless authorised by order, protocol and training; extreme limits make alarms useless.

monitoring_concepts.text: Record set and delivered values, airway pressures, SpO2, end-tidal CO2 and waveforms at the policy frequency, and trends.

escalation_concepts.text: Call for help early for rising pressures, falling volumes, desaturation or distress.
